official_source_validation.geometry_semantics: indicative position and extent; not a definitive legal boundary

acceptance_checks: Validate exact canonical Git blob SHA and exactly 92283 unique parcel rows
Resolve exactly parcel_30762 through parcel_30773 and unique HMLR INSPIRE IDs
Discover London Borough of Enfield GML only from the current official HMLR download page
Hash downloaded GML and stream-parse only the single detected supported feature schema
Match target identifiers only through the exact identifier field required by the single detected feature schema
Require exactly one official supported cadastral feature per target reference
Require recognised OGC GML namespace geometry with Polygon, MultiPolygon, MultiSurface, Surface or PolygonPatch primitives
Require exactly one valid exterior LinearRing per polygon primitive and require every interior LinearRing to be valid
Require at least four coordinate tuples, first coordinate equal to last, non-zero area, no zero-length segment and no self-intersection
Reject foreign geometry namespaces and explicitly declared conflicting CRS; accept EPSG:27700 or inherited CRS with no conflicting local declaration
Require coordinate text to contain only finite numeric lexical tokens; malformed or non-finite values are rejected rather than skipped
Require one and only one coordinate encoding family per LinearRing and exactly one posList or coordinates node when those encodings are used
Require srsDimension to be an integer from 2 to 4 and require exact ordinate cardinality for pos, posList and coordinates tuples
Require each interior ring to lie strictly within its exterior ring and never intersect or touch the exterior boundary
Require interior rings in the same polygon to neither cross nor nest; islands require a separate polygon primitive
Detect exactly one supported feature schema: recognised INSPIRE CadastralParcel or unnamespaced HMLR PREDEFINED; reject mixed and unrecognised schemas
For HMLR PREDEFINED compatibility, match target identifiers only through exact NATIONALCADASTRALREFERENCE fields; LABEL or INSPIREID alone is insufficient
When PREDEFINED INSPIREID is present, require it to equal the exact NATIONALCADASTRALREFERENCE target
Require exactly one direct INSPIRE geometry property and exactly one recognised GML geometry root inside it
Reject any recognised polygon or surface primitive outside the accepted feature geometry scope
For HMLR PREDEFINED compatibility, require either exactly one direct GML geometry root or exactly one unnamespaced GEOMETRY wrapper containing exactly one root; reject mixed or multiple scopes
Treat INSPIRE extent as indicative and never definitive legal title extent
Infer no UPRN, address point or unproven parcel binding
Write exact row-by-row evidence only to progress_wave23_exact_result_latest.json, preserve candidate and audit progress files, fake rows zero and final_ready false
Compute the canonical Git blob SHA-1 incrementally and scan the 92283-feature GeoJSON through mmap without loading the full file into Python objects
Stream official GML or ZIP payloads to bounded temporary files and compute the extracted GML SHA-256 during the same pass
Limit ZIP archives to 128 members, exactly one safe GML member, 256 MiB extracted size and compression ratio at most 250
Keep mapped temporary payloads alive only for the exact parse and clean all descriptors and temporary files in a finally block
Require the download index and every initial download URL to use HTTPS on port 443 with no userinfo, fragment, control character, trailing-dot host or IP literal
Validate every redirect target before the redirected request is sent; keep the download index on the primary service host
Allow binary download redirects only to the primary service host or the HM Land Registry landregistry.gov.uk domain family and reject all other hosts

retry_policy.retry_when: official GML binary transport is reachable and a fresh no-live-owner readback passes
